svg.title: Animated: “The cat sat on the” is split into five tokens with IDs, which fill the context window. The model gives a probability for every possible next token. Top-p 0.8 keeps the likeliest three, and the sampler picks “ mat”, which is appended to the context. The loop runs again and appends a full stop.
